top_choice_rationale: Pd-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling (Buchwald and Hartwig) is a mechanistically understood, independently confirmed method used daily for about three decades, with two independent ligand families that make a two-person allocation clean. The citation can be framed around the general catalytic method, which respects the Kosugi/Migita precursors. P001 follows as the most transformative idea but carries open attribution (Sakamoto, Ciulli, Gray, Ito, Kim omitted) and no approved PROTAC; P004 is mature and cleanly credited but follows recent computational prizes; P003 combines two achievements in a three-person split that is less settled. No award is ranked last because several mature, defensible awards exist.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, who is not a candidate, and no tie to any credited person
